title: Cape Girardeau crash with small bodies and priest

tellings.quote:
there
was bodies small diminutive bodies that
a reverend or a priest was asked to come
deliver last rights to because
apparently one of them was still alive

plain: In 1941, something is said to have crashed near Cape Girardeau, Missouri, leaving small bodies behind, and a reverend or priest was asked to give last rites because one of them was apparently still alive. John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, and who says he was himself taken by an alien, retells it on Michels's show without naming his source.
